title: Telemetry
summary: Portal-independent playtest funnel: a C module that batches named game events into small JSON POSTs to the studio collector (ai_studio/telemetry), dormant without a collector URL.
dependencies: external/neotolis-engine http (nt_http) for the default transport; the stub backend keeps the module quiet
ai_studio/telemetry collector for the wire format and the report
provides: telemetry_config_t / telemetry_init: collector URL, key, game, build, platform, player id
telemetry_update: heartbeat while playing, interval flush, one POST in flight, retry with backoff
telemetry_make_id: 32-hex anonymous id for the game to persist
does_not_own: which moments a game reports (the game's own funnel module names them)
the player id's persistence (a game save field)
the collector, its storage and the report (ai_studio/telemetry)
